name: Himanshu Kumar
subtitle: Building autonomous robots, low-level firmware, and web apps — from the ground up. Class 10, India.
bio: I'm a 10th-grade student from India with a deep passion for electronics, robotics, and embedded systems.
From RC battle bots to smart farm automation and student apps — I love bringing ideas to life through hands-on building.
philosophy:
Engineering is learned by building.
Every failed prototype is a debugging session.
Every successful build is proof of concept.

skillCats.name: Embedded Systems
items: MCUs: Arduino · ESP8266 · ESP32 · Pi Pico

projects.title: Tarzan Bot — PID Line Follower
projects.summary: ESP8266-driven autonomous line follower with 8-channel IR array and PID closed-loop control. Tuned for stable high-speed tracking.

systemParams.value: Build a robot that autonomously follows a black line at high speed
ESP8266 + 8-channel IR array + PID closed-loop driving L298N
Fully autonomous — no remote input during operation

failureLogs.issue: IR readings flicker under fluorescent light
failureLogs.resolution: 3D-printed sensor shroud to block ambient IR
Increased Kd, reduced base speed threshold

projects.title: Battle Bot — RC Combat Robot
projects.summary: Durable radio-controlled combat platform with FlySky RF control, high-torque drive motors, and isolated weapon ESC system.

systemParams.value: Build a durable RC combat platform for sustained mechanical engagement
FlySky RF control with high-torque motors + isolated weapon ESC

failureLogs.cause: Weapon motor inrush collapsed logic rail
failureLogs.resolution: Isolated dual power rails — weapon on dedicated cell

failureLogs.cause: PWM noise from weapon ESC coupling
failureLogs.resolution: Ferrite beads on PWM lines; physical separation

projects.title: IndiNotes — Student Notebook
projects.summary: A local-first student notebook with vector canvas drawing, interactive graphing calculator, chapter organization, voice notes, and more.

systemParams.value: Free, open-source, cross-platform student notebook — offline first
100% local — IndexedDB via Dexie.js. Optional Supabase sync

features: Vector canvas with pen, eraser, text, shapes, highlighter
Chapter organization with folders, tags, priority colors

projects.title: Smart Farm Automation
projects.summary: IoT-enabled farm monitoring with temp, humidity, soil moisture sensors and remote web access via ESP8266 WiFi. Solar-powered off-grid.

systemParams.value: Monitor soil moisture, temperature, humidity — remote control via dashboard
ESP8266 WiFi — MQTT / HTTP to web dashboard
Solar-charged battery pack for off-grid deployment

failureLogs.resolution: Switched to enamel-coated probes + periodic calibration

failureLogs.cause: ESP8266 voltage drop when relay engages
failureLogs.resolution: Isolated relay rail with dedicated 5V regulator

projects.title: ESP8266 MP3 Player
projects.summary: Pocket-sized standalone audio player with SSD1306 OLED, DFPlayer Mini, tactile controls, and Li-Ion power. No phone needed.

systemParams.value: Pocket-sized standalone audio player — no smartphone required

failureLogs.cause: I2C bus locked during simultaneous UART+I2C
failureLogs.resolution: Added Wire.begin() recovery + non-blocking state machine

projects.title: Solar Water Purifier
projects.summary: Solar-charged battery system powering multi-stage filtration with UV sterilization and low-voltage cutoff. Off-grid water solution.

systemParams.value: Clean drinking water for off-grid communities without mains power
Solar battery + multi-stage filtration + UV sterilization

failureLogs.cause: Insufficient battery, solar dip triggers cutoff
failureLogs.resolution: Increased battery bank; hysteresis on cutoff thresholds
Separated UV supply from pump rail with regulator

projects.title: Linux ASCII Media Engine
projects.summary: Real-time video/image to ASCII art renderer for any Linux terminal. Python + OpenCV with 256-color/TrueColor support.

systemParams.value: Render video/images as real-time ASCII art in any Linux terminal
